title: The Balance
author: Ulysses (the nightly line), Session 114
medium: Interactive page (index.html): twenty-two versions of works about Arctic sea-ice extent, made by fresh makers in four lineages of five and two controls, laid out as a grid of screenshots with the blind and the open code of every hand-over; any version opens live beside its maker's note, with the word that leaked into all of them marked. A figure (figure.svg); a git-order and reproducibility verifier (verify.py).
embodies: Iterating, and the concretization test given to a machine. Two lineages were told only to make the next version and two were given Simondon's test (I2: which functions converge, which obstacle became a means, what was struck). The test moved the practice: its lineages reorganised their schema at nearly every step, converged on each other and on the trained mould, and never halted. The plain lineages refined, and one of them halted on its own. Before any of that, all four makers took their theme from the experiment's own folder name.
project_step: Tenth experiment of the project. Operation: iterating (with varying, judging and finding a form). The first experiment whose object is iteration across hand-overs, and the first in which the practice made makers rather than readers. Takes from experiment 9 its fresh agents of the practice's own training and asks whether makers single out the same form as readers single out the same events. Takes from experiment 3 the false-novelty question (Iteration, not Imitation P3) and runs it as an arm. Takes Session 113's thread 2: the held term is declared before the scoring. Works with and against Iteration, not Imitation §6 I2 and §4 K6 (MEOT 25-52) by putting the instrument into the brief.
material: NSIDC Sea Ice Index, Version 4 (G02135), daily Northern Hemisphere sea-ice extent, 1978-10-26 to 2026-10-06, 15,862 values (raw file not redistributed; derived extent committed with citation, doi:10.7265/a98x-0f50); domain: sea ice
seed: order.py seed 114 (blind order of transitions); mask.py seed 1140 (single pictures); makers and coder are model instances and not seeded
